name: Xinzhou

routes.outcome: Official Shanxi Natural Resources Department portal identified Xinzhou municipal natural-resources contact information and links to Shanxi Tianditu and other public services. No parcel schema or anonymous parcel endpoint was exposed in the landing page.
Official Webmap.cn search result identifies the Xinzhou Planning and Natural Resources Bureau subsite; direct retrieval was attempted separately.
TLS-verified GET returned a CloudWAF page stating the request was intercepted as suspected attack behavior. No bypass or retry intended to defeat the WAF was attempted.
TLS-verified GET timed out after 20 seconds before viewer HTML or JavaScript configuration could be retrieved. TLS verification was not disabled.

Official government-hosted PDF search result lists the Xinzhou Natural Resources and Real Estate Registration Center among municipal registration centers; it does not expose parcel geometry or an API.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: No parcel feature request was sent because the official public viewer was blocked or timed out before a documented public endpoint could be established.

qualification.reason: A local Xinzhou registration custodian and official provincial/public-map discovery are evidenced, but WAF blocking and timeout prevented independent qualification of a current public service, schema, CRS, native ID, anonymous geometry access, or sample parcel.

scopeLimits: A zero exact-point hit, map extent miss, timeout, login wall, or unusable UI is not treated as evidence of citywide absence.
No citywide parcel coverage, update cadence, licensing terms, or public anonymous parcel query behavior was established.
No GeoJSON is retained because no safe native identity plus unchanged full parcel polygon was returned.
Scratch request output is under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/xinzhou/; prior logs and artifacts were not cleared.
This packet documents research only and does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: The Xinzhou registration custodian and official Shanxi public-map discovery are evidenced, but current viewer/API availability, service URL, layer schema, CRS, native parcel identity, anonymous access, and exact-point parcel response remain unverified.
